findings.reason: without the waits, s12's declared gate is dispatched before the reductions its bound depends on and is measured against a station that cannot pass it, which is the failure the s89 wait was added to prevent.
findings.text: `s12`'s depends-on is `[s8,s9,s10,s11,s13,s88,s89,s90]`, but s12 gates "all crew monitor processes together read under 20 MB/min" and "the station's CPU is under 5% of one core", while s91's own Why measures `ledger.read_records` at 26.7% of station samples and s92's measures `compose_owed_plan_reviews` at 22.7% plus 5.4% and 5.2% under it, on a station already at 4.37/2.98 GB/min and 83%/95% of one core — so s12 can be admitted and dispatched into a measurement the two unlanded sections are what make reachable

findings.reason: the worker must either add a fourth (second unchanged) pass or discover the zero is unobservable, which is a change to the node's whole measure.
findings.text: the test "runs `compose_owed_plan_reviews` in dry-run three times: unchanged, then after one review record is rewritten, then after one plan file is edited", yet it "asserts zero of both on the second pass of the unchanged state": with one unchanged pass in the run there is no second unchanged pass, and a cold unchanged pass must decode the 400 records, so the assertion as written cannot be the one the described sequence observes

findings.reason: the plan-file half of the endpoint can regress (a cache keyed on the review store alone passes every stated assertion) and the gate would not show it.
findings.text: the Deliverable requires "a pass after one review record or one plan file changes decodes only that record or plan", but the done-when asserts a record count only for the record-changed pass ("at most one record") and asserts nothing decoded or scanned for the plan-file-edited pass beyond composed-set equality

findings.reason: the section's endpoint is the station's pass, so a gate that proves it for a different pass mode leaves the deliverable unmeasured where it matters and the worker without a decision on which pass is meant.
findings.text: every pass the done-when measures is `dry_run=True`, but the pass the Why measures is the station's tick: at head `compose_owed_plan_reviews` skips `_weighed_edits` (`weighed = _weighed_edits(project) if not dry_run else {}`, plan_review.py:4590) and applies `PLAN_REVIEW_PASS_LIMIT` only when `not dry_run`, so the test exercises a read set the tick does not take and a cache serving only the preview path would pass it

findings.reason: the section's endpoint and gate rest on `_collect`/`_load` and the profile file, both of which resolve, so correcting a parenthetical in the Why changes no node and costs the worker one grep.
findings.text: the cited decode chain names `_from_parsed_string` and `select_wildcard`, which match no definition anywhere in the repository at head or at the cited tree `e52a8aa248` (`git grep` over `*.py` at both), so two of the three frames offered as the 11% evidence cannot be checked from the tree the plan names
